patthana9.10:1.1: Naāsavaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nanoāsavaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana9.10:3.1: Nasāsavaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naanāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana9.10:5.1: Naāsavasampayuttaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naāsavavippayuttaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana9.10:7.1: Naāsavañceva naanāsavañca nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naanāsavañceva nano ca āsavaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana9.10:9.1: Naāsavañceva naāsavavippayuttañca nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naāsavavippayuttañceva nano ca āsavaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana9.10:11.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ nasāsavaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… āsavavippayuttaṃ naanāsavaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
